0.1.5: Print a page with Cmd+P, or save it as a PDF from the File menu.
Zoom pages in and out from the View menu. Sela remembers the level for each site.
Tabs that play sound show a speaker. Click it, or press Cmd+Shift+M, to mute them.
Search a site from the command bar: type yt cats, gh swift or w otters. Add your own in Settings.
Turn on developer tools in Settings > General to inspect pages.
0.1.4: Add Web Extensions, such as uBlock Origin or Dark Reader, in Settings on macOS 15.4 or later.
Links from other apps open in Little Sela, a small window of their own.
Give a space its own profile from its menu, with its own logins and cookies.
Reader mode shows an article in a clean layout. Press Cmd+Shift+R.
A playing video floats in picture in picture when you switch tabs or apps.
Tab Overview shows the space's tabs as a grid. Press Cmd+Shift+Backslash.
